_notes.purpose: Grade-1 word list for visual_confusion Levels 3-4 and blend_required content, per question_content_spec.md and independent_activity_stepup_spec.md
_notes.source_update: Entries marked source: 'workbook_verified' are taken directly from the uploaded Sinhala Grade 1 workbook (Ministry of Education / Educational Publications Department, www.edupub.gov.lk) - picture-matching and sentence-building pages. These replace earlier guessed entries wherever a real curriculum word was found covering the same letter/pair.
_notes.confirmed_grade1_letter_set: Page 32 of the workbook ('build a word from the letters in the basket') officially lists these consonants as active Grade-1 letters: ස ට හ ඉ ක ද අ ව ප ග ල ර ය ම. This is a useful cross-check against grade1_akshara_table.json - any of these should be in_grade1_scope: true; letters NOT in this list (including ඨ, ධ, ඛ, ඣ - the rare pair-partners flagged earlier) still need separate verification before being treated as active Grade-1 content.
_notes.still_needs_verification: ට/ඨ, ද/ධ, බ/ඛ, ජ/ඣ pairs - the rare-letter side (ඨ, ධ, ඛ, ඣ) was NOT found anywhere in the uploaded workbook pages. This further supports the earlier recommendation: check with your supervisor whether these four letters should remain in_grade1_scope: true at all, or whether the confusable_pairs list should drop the rare side and those pairs should not be active visual_confusion targets for Grade 1.

confidence_key.high: Common, everyday Grade-1-level word, reasonably confident in accuracy

confidence_key.verify: Uses a rare/formal letter or less common vocabulary - MUST be checked against actual textbook/native speaker before use with children
confidence_key.picture_ref: All null for now - fill in once image assets exist, per independent_activity_stepup_spec.md section 4
